nodes.label: ADR 0189: Discogs playlists: vinyl and digital together, kept under Discogs
nodes.rationale: Vinyl-only tracks live under Discogs only, so the library (All tracks, counts, duplicates, Engine DJ) is untouched. Vinyl as songs in the library was rejected: thousands of songs that can't play or be analysed, to keep out of analysis, duplicates and exports. Auto playlists filter by genre, style, artist, label, year and format, vinyl or digital. A Discogs playlist is a collection list so it syncs, backs up and bins like any other. Auto playlists are worked out live rather than stored as items, so each new read of the collection is followed without a step.
